description: Zig-zag paver tile in an 8x4 inch format from Pak Clay, an interlocking-style outdoor piece for driveways, paths and porches. The zig-zag edge locks neighbouring pieces together and gives a distinctive pattern when laid. Pavers perform best on a compacted, well-drained base with edge restraint and a slight fall away from walls. For vehicle areas, confirm thickness and suitability with us first. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Cement jali tile from Pak Clay, a perforated cement piece for balcony screens, boundary wall bands and façade panels. The openings let air and light through while partly screening the view. Cement is heavier than many materials, so check the supporting slab or frame, protect the joints from water and ask a mason about sealing or painting. Compare it with our terracotta jali for a warmer look. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Terracotta tile in a 12x12 inch square format from Pak Clay, a larger piece that covers floor area quickly with fewer joints. Fired clay gives a warm, natural colour that suits living rooms, verandahs and courtyards. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base, keep standing water off it and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Shade can vary between pieces, so order extra from one batch. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural handmade terracotta hexagon tile in a 6x6 inch size from Pak Clay, suited to bathroom walls, splashbacks and feature panels. The six-sided shape tessellates into a honeycomb pattern, and handmade clay brings slight variation in tone and edge. Terracotta is porous, so ask about sealing in wet areas and use suitable adhesive and grout. Check how it looks beside your fittings before ordering. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
